content: The Australian Counselling Association (ACA) is a non-profit professional organization that is committed to supporting and advancing the field of counselling. It serves as the exclusive representative body for professional counsellors in Australia. The mission of the Australian Counselling Association is to improve the quality of life within society by fostering the professional development of counsellors, advancing the counselling profession, and utilizing counselling practices to uphold and promote respect for human dignity and diversity. Currently, the counselling profession in Australia is not regulated by the government. As a result, clients are required to independently assess the qualifications of various counsellors and psychotherapists. The ACA, alongside the Psychotherapy and Counselling Federation of Australia (PACFA), is actively advocating for government accreditation of the counselling profession in Australia.
